lead: An acceptance `want` is a substring of a tool's own output, so rewording a summary line breaks a check in a stage you are not touching.
body: The owners roster summary is read by a floor check wanting `, 0 owned by a retired goal`, and rewriting those counts into the `label: N` form a live stage asked for would have gone red on a stage that passed sessions ago. Before you reword any line a tool prints, grep `data/goals/` for a fragment of it — a mode whose output is a verdict can take the new form while the human-facing roster keeps the frozen sentence.
